provenance.scope: Consumer interpretation catalog; original backend catalog unavailable

notes: Definitions, units, lookbacks, and publication lags are preserved from local feature cards.
Lookbacks count trading observations, not calendar days or forecast sessions; recursive history may exceed nominal lookbacks.
Decimal ratios use 0.02 for 2%; RSI changes use points; PVO outputs use percentage points.
Foreign/non-regular publication lag is already applied to emitted values; do not shift them again.
Null, zero, and omitted fields are distinct. A binary zero may reflect unavailable underlying warmup comparisons.
Catalog definitions do not establish freshness, continuity, raw OHLCV availability, or a complete model vector.

Accumulation Distribution Line Decreasin.meaning: 1 when normalized least-squares slope of previous 5 cumulative ADL observations < 0; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Accumulation Distribution Line Increasin.meaning: 1 when normalized least-squares slope of previous 5 cumulative ADL observations > 0; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

ADL Change 5D Normalized.lookback_sessions: cumulative history plus 20 rows and 5-row difference

ADX Strong Trend.meaning: 1 when ADX Value >= 25; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Aroon Change Position.meaning: 1 when (Aroon Up >= Aroon Down) differs from previous row; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Aroon Down Trend.meaning: 1 when Aroon Down >= 70; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Aroon Up Trend.meaning: 1 when Aroon Up >= 70; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

ATR Bearish.meaning: 1 when ATR buy-stop is present; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

ATR Bullish.meaning: 1 when ATR sell-stop is present; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

ATR Percent 14D.meaning: EWM(true range, alpha=1/14, adjust=False, min_periods=14) / Close

Bear Power 80% Negatives.meaning: 1 when at least 8 of previous 10 Bear Power observations are < 0; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Bear Power Trend.meaning: 1 when normalized least-squares slope of previous 10 Bear Power observations < 0; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Bollinger Overbought.meaning: 1 when Close >= upper band; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Bollinger Oversold.meaning: 1 when Close <= lower band; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Bull Power 80% Positives.meaning: 1 when at least 8 of previous 10 Bull Power observations are > 0; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Bull Power Up Trend.meaning: 1 when normalized least-squares slope of previous 10 Bull Power observations > 0; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Crossover CMF.meaning: 1 when CMF(t-1)*CMF(t) <= 0 (includes touching zero); 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Directional Index Spread.meaning: Plus Directional Index - Minus Directional Index

Dollar Volume Ratio 20D.meaning: Close*Volume / mean(Close*Volume,20); local IDR traded-value proxy despite name

Donchian Overbought.meaning: 1 when Close >= upper band; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Donchian Oversold.meaning: 1 when Close <= lower band; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Fisher Change 5D.lookback_sessions: 10; recursive smoothing; trigger adds 1 and change adds 5 rows

Fisher Down Trend.meaning: 1 when Fisher <= -2; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Fisher Reversal.meaning: 1 when (Fisher >= trigger) differs from previous row; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.

Fisher Spread.lookback_sessions: 10; recursive smoothing; trigger adds 1 and change adds 5 rows

MACD Non-Near 0 Positive.meaning: 1 when raw histogram >= threshold; threshold is median absolute raw MACD histogram over last 50 rows, min 10, falling back to expanding median; 0 otherwise. Generator comparisons can yield 0 during underlying warmup.
